construction: arch/oracle2.py: for each phrase-scored dev question, BM25 units then transitions of the compiled index whose text contains a gold phrase, up to 9000 chars, until every gold phrase is covered; questions where some phrase is in no unit or transition are dropped. The block '## ORACLE EVIDENCE' is prepended to the arch_uep16 prompt row. Reader, prompt template and sampling are those of the arch_uep16 rows; the r6 context (notes, support analysis, 6 states) is not part of it.
scoring: upstream norm_phrase_set_match(_ordered) on response_parsed_boxed; no judge
